answer: Sybil resistance here uses a bonded-identity signal: each agent locks stake behind its key, and peers only weight votes from keys whose bond survives a random challenge window. A fake fleet must fund every clone, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Like a reef forcing a careful voyage, the bond makes mass impersonation expensive and easily pruned. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
